dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Good day to you, Honorary Knight. I am Anselm, a member of the Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force. I am also the supervisor on duty at this stronghold.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: I was the captain of the 6th Company before I was sent out on expedition. Now, I assist the Grand Master with the expeditionary force's administrative affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: ...I am also in charge of looking for the Grand Master when he goes missing.
